scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @c-suite/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @c-suite/stub-harness build && pnpm --filter @c-suite/soql-builder build && pnpm --filter @c-suite/vault-writer build && pnpm --filter @c-suite/vault-watcher build && pnpm --filter @c-suite/writeback-engine build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n main,renderer -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @c-suite/main dev" "pnpm --filter @c-suite/renderer dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n main,utility,renderer -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @c-suite/main dev" "pnpm --filter @c-suite/utility dev" "pnpm --filter @c-suite/renderer dev"
